items.text: On December 20, Frank Capra's It's a Wonderful Life, with James Stewart and Donna Reed, was released in New York.
items.question: Do you remember the first time you saw It's a Wonderful Life, and who you watched it with?
items.source_quote: December 20 – Frank Capra's It's a Wonderful Life, featuring James Stewart, Donna Reed, Lionel Barrymore, Henry Travers and Thomas Mitchell, is released in New York.

items.text: On October 15, the St. Louis Cardinals beat the Boston Red Sox, 4 games to 3, to win the World Series.
items.question: Who in your family followed the Cardinals and the Red Sox in the World Series that fall, and which team were they for?
items.source_quote: October 15 – The St. Louis Cardinals defeat the Boston Red Sox, 4 games to 3, to win their 6th World Series.
